text:
Mira Patel: dropping a new variant - hollow diamond ◊ as the required mark in the console forms (instead of asterisk/dot). trying to keep visual noise low for dense pages. figma: https://figma.redwood/company/forms-diamond

Priya Desai: interesting! diamond reads as a shape rather than punctuation. main question: discoverability for quick scanners and colorblind users.

Jonah Rivera: if we run an A/B, metric to watch: field-level errors triggered on first submit and support mentions referencing "missing required". also track time-to-complete for the form.

Alex Morgan: dev note: show explicit "Required" helper only on focus or hover. keep aria-required on the input always. for inline errors, validate on blur for non-empty fields, otherwise wait until submit.

Kevin Liu: accessibility notes: aria-required=true, aria-invalid=true when failing, aria-describedby -> error id. role=alert on new inline errors so SRs announce them. for top summary, make links focus the field using tabindex=-1 and element.focus().

Mira Patel: destructive flows: propose typed-confirm (type full resource name) for org/workspace deletes; checkbox + danger CTA for batch deletions. always show undo snackbar when server supports reversal (7s).

Priya Desai: copy: prefer contextual instruction "Type the workspace name to confirm" and monospace input. for checkbox modal, include short line: "This cannot be undone" and a secondary cancel button.

Alex Morgan: implementation gotcha: avoid duplicate announcements (summary + inline). only role=alert the one users need to act on. restore focus after closing modals.

Kevin Liu: also ensure typed-confirm instruction is announced at modal open via aria-live=polite, and errors in that flow are role=alert.

Mira Patel: action items:
- design: add diamond + focus 'Required' state (Priya + Mira)
- eng: ensure aria-required/aria-describedby and non-duplicated announcements (Alex + Kevin)
- analytics: instrument form metrics and A/B (Jonah)
- PM: draft typed-confirm policy and undo window (Mira)

design-bot: added to Thu review agenda. :spiral_calendar:

Jonah Rivera: I'll add the A/B dashboard spec.

Mira Patel: thanks team, will post updated frames by Wed EOD. :thumbsup:
